+/* RISC-V RVV based wcschrnul.
+   Copyright (C) 2026 Free Software Foundation, Inc.
+   This file is part of the GNU C Library.
+   Licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1+; see COPYING.LESSER.  */
+
+#include <sysdep.h>
+#include <sys/asm.h>
+
+#ifndef WCSCHRNUL
+# define WCSCHRNUL __wcschrnul
+#endif
+
+#define wcs a0
+#define wc a1
+#define vl_reg a3
+#define first a5
+#define post_vl a6
+
+#define vchunk v16
+#define vhit v0
+#define vtmp v1
+
+ENTRY (WCSCHRNUL)
+.option push
+.option arch, +v
+L(loop):
+	vsetvli	vl_reg, zero, e32, m8, ta, ma
+	vle32ff.v	vchunk, (wcs)
+	vmseq.vx	vtmp, vchunk, wc
+	vmseq.vi	vhit, vchunk, 0
+	vmor.mm	vhit, vhit, vtmp
+	vfirst.m	first, vhit
+	bgez	first, L(found)
+	csrr	post_vl, vl
+	add	wcs, wcs, post_vl
+	j	L(loop)
+L(found):
+	slli	first, first, 2
+	add	a0, wcs, first
+	ret
+.option pop
+END (WCSCHRNUL)
diff --git a/sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/riscv/multiarch/wcschrnul.c b/sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/riscv/multiarch/wcschrnul.c
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..ba5b69dfef
--- /dev/null
+++ b/sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/riscv/multiarch/wcschrnul.c
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+/* Multiple versions of wcschrnul.
+   All versions must be listed in ifunc-impl-list.c.
+   Copyright (C) 2026 Free Software Foundation, Inc.
+   This file is part of the GNU C Library.
+   Licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1+; see COPYING.LESSER.  */
+
+#if IS_IN (libc)
+# undef wcschrnul
+# define wcschrnul __redirect_wcschrnul
+# include <stdint.h>
+# include <wchar.h>
+# include <ifunc-init.h>
+# include <riscv-ifunc.h>
+# include <sys/hwprobe.h>
+
+extern __typeof (__redirect_wcschrnul) __libc_wcschrnul;
+
+extern __typeof (__redirect_wcschrnul) __wcschrnul_generic attribute_hidden;
+extern __typeof (__redirect_wcschrnul) __wcschrnul_vector attribute_hidden;
+
+static inline __typeof (__redirect_wcschrnul) *
+select_wcschrnul_ifunc (uint64_t dl_hwcap, __riscv_hwprobe_t hwprobe_func)
+{
+  unsigned long long v;
+
+  if (__riscv_hwprobe_one (hwprobe_func, RISCV_HWPROBE_KEY_IMA_EXT_0, &v) == 0
+      && (v & RISCV_HWPROBE_IMA_V) == RISCV_HWPROBE_IMA_V)
+    return __wcschrnul_vector;
+
+  return __wcschrnul_generic;
+}
+
+riscv_libc_ifunc (__libc_wcschrnul, select_wcschrnul_ifunc);
+
+# undef wcschrnul
+strong_alias (__libc_wcschrnul, wcschrnul);
+strong_alias (wcschrnul, __wcschrnul)
+# ifdef SHARED
+__hidden_ver1 (wcschrnul, __GI_wcschrnul, __redirect_wcschrnul)
+  __attribute__ ((visibility ("hidden"))) __attribute_copy__ (wcschrnul);
+# endif
+#else
+# include <wcsmbs/wcschrnul.c>
+#endif
